objective: Test a source-scaled complete foam-cluster primitive before whole-wave integration.
hypothesis: A source-scaled continuous foam cluster with unequal returning lobes, connected water incursions and related tapered open marks yields a coherent local froth primitive.
baseline: P090 source distinctions verified; P091 isolated Cs on narrow support failed.
otherGoalProtection: Bounded source-scaled primitive, no full-scene variants, no copied upstream implementation, first-view rejection before integrity checks.

result.summary: Standalone source-scaled primitive rendered with variable-weight ink; independent review rejected three flat repeating lobes with decorative spirals. Lead did not implement promised subordinate silhouette returns, so complete-cluster premise remains untested. Stop tuning; require one annotated parent/child source group before another construction.
result.nextAction: Identify one parent and subordinate sky-facing returns in source, distinguishing interior curls and distant connected-water boundary before implementing the missing hierarchy.

findings: The planned hierarchical primitive was reduced to a flat lobe row. This is lead implementation failure, not falsification of a fully specified nested construction; reviewer caught missing hypothesis coverage.
Variable-weight ink alone gives no retained source gain. Upstream stroke principle informed mark rendering; no retrospective attribution to previous work, no copied code.
Local source juxtaposition was more discriminating than another full-wave view, but counts alone cannot establish hierarchy; exact parent/child source mapping required.

actions.summary: Archive flat-row primitive; no parameter rescue or integration.
Specify source parent plus subordinate outer returns and internal marks before building. Water incursions need not correspond one-for-one to outer tips.

review.nextImprovement: One bounded parent annotation with explicit relationship labels, then implement exactly the observed hierarchy.
